messages:
rina (PM): quick sync: customer Z asked for an adaptive pin flow that can expand cohort size automatically if metrics look good. they want clear rollback gates and an eval sampling plan. what do we need to specify to ship an MVP?
sam (ML Eng): core pieces: per-tenant pin record, cohort selector, and an autoscaler that increases traffic from 1% -> up to 50% by rule. autoscale should be metric-driven with safety caps.
morgan (Research): sampling plan: stratified sampling across prompt length, intent bucket, and user agent. suggest tiers: short/med/long prompts with 5k samples each initially; surface both token-level and embedding-level deltas.
pavel (Infra): infra constraints: autoscale must respect node budget and not spin >2x baseline GPUs. add quota guard: max_cohort_nodes and global concurrency cap. also need transparent billing delta per cohort.
joy (CS): customers want an "explainable rollback" reason in the UI: show which metric tripped and example failing prompts. also need a one-click pause and pin-exempt option per tenant.
rollout-bot: scheduled canary for model-3 -> cohort-internal at 2026-06-02T08:00:00Z. monitors: p95_latency, error_rate, embed_cosine_median.
rina (PM): acceptance criteria (MVP): 1) API to create pin with autoscale rules, 2) eval pipeline deposits metrics to s3 + dashboard, 3) alert-driven rollback that records reason and sample examples, 4) customer-facing pause/unpin.
sam (ML Eng): policy proto - simple rule language:
```
autoscale: {
  start_pct: 1,
  max_pct: 50,
  step_pct: [1,5,10],
  watch: [{metric: "embed_cos_drop", op: ">", threshold: 0.06, duration: "30m"},
          {metric: "p95_latency_delta", op: ">", threshold: 40, duration: "15m"}]
}
```
if any watch rule trips -> step back one step; if persistent -> rollback.
morgan (Research): add quality watch: `human-sample-fail_rate > 1% over 200 samples` -> pause. we will run daily automated spot-checks and flag prompts with >.15 embedding drop.
pavel (Infra): ops needs: (A) per-cohort cost estimate preflight, (B) circuit-breaker to prevent more than 5 active autoscaling cohorts, (C) logs retention path for audits.
joy (CS): can we show an "expected cost delta" in the pin creation flow? customers ask for a preflight estimate.
rina (PM): yes. owner map: sam -> autoscale rules and rollback CLI, morgan -> sampling harness + thresholds, pavel -> infra caps + cost estimator, joy -> UX copy + examples for customers. follow-up: ship RFC by Wed, prototype demo next Tue.
